bio.text: Sean Kirrane is the Republican candidate for New Jersey's 5th Congressional District in 2026, challenging Rep. Josh Gottheimer; the New Jersey Globe reported that John Aslanian ended his Republican primary campaign, leaving Kirrane unopposed for the nomination.
The New Jersey Globe described him as a corporate consultant and artificial intelligence entrepreneur and a father of two from River Vale.
The New Jersey Globe reported that he had never run for office before.

sources.title: 'Socially moderate' Republican will challenge Josh Gottheimer in NJ-5
Aslanian ends run for Congress, endorses Kirrane
